plan.rationale: Brad From Finance EP. 1 — 'Murphy the Goldendoodle' (writer-agent Draft 4). Negation-that-confirms: Sierra delivers 'Brad From Finance is decentered. I do not think about Brad.' while every detail confirms she has a full dossier on his life. P12 (cafe medium close-up, Wardrobe A cream cropped blazer + navy underneath, looking up from MacBook with faint smile) is the visual — looks like a creator about to deliver a 'report.' Newscaster-coded. Was P32 originally; switched to P12 to avoid the bedroom+athleisure NSFW filter and because cafe/desk fits the Brad newscaster bit better thematically.

script_chunks.text: I DO NOT THINK ABOUT BRAD.
I DO NOT KNOW BRAD GOT A DOG.
I DO NOT KNOW MURPHY'S BIRTHDAY.

plan.voiceover_text: Brad From Finance is decentered. I do not think about Brad. I do not know Brad got a dog — a goldendoodle, named Murphy. I do not know Murphy's birthday is March 14th. A Pisces. Brad who?
plan.caption: Murphy if you're seeing this happy belated 🐕
comedic_devices_used: negation-that-confirms — every denial is a receipt
escalating specificity (dog → breed → name → birthday → astrological sign)

plan.writer_micro_edit: If technically possible, add a one-frame cut to Sierra holding her phone face-down on the cafe table when she says 'Brad who?' — gives the voiceover a physical lie to point at.
